achievements.name: Don't Let Him Sweep the Leg
achievements.wikiTitle: Don't Let Him Sweep the Leg
achievements.description: Defeat Raksha, the Shadow Colossus without letting him use his 'Tail Sweep' attack in phase 4.
achievements.wikiSummary: Don't Let Him Sweep the Leg is an achievement that requires the player to defeat Raksha, the Shadow Colossus without letting him use his 'Tail Sweep' attack in phase 4.
achievements.wikiText:
Don't Let Him Sweep the Leg is an achievement that requires the player to defeat Raksha, the Shadow Colossus without letting him use his 'Tail Sweep' attack in phase 4.

## Strategy

Raksha will use Tail Sweep if the player is within two tiles of him after two auto-attacks. Outside of this range, he will instead launch a shadow bomb that inflicts a five second stun and bind.

Try to damage Raksha as quickly as possible, alternating between Freedom and Anticipation on their cooldowns. There is a small lull during the start of the phase after two of these interlude attacks, after which he uses the Shadow Detonation attack. Players can slightly stall their damage and then destroy the shield to gather shadow anima fragments, which can be used to deal even more damage and end the encounter quicker.

Clear Headed and Reflexes can help with managing cooldowns for stun immunity. Transfigure is also an option as it grants 15 seconds of stun immunity, but it comes with the cost of self-stunning the player for 6 seconds upon activation, so careful timing must be utilised.

If the bombs have to be tanked, use of defensive abilities like Barricade and Immortality are helpful, along with staying at high health as the bomb will deal heavy magic damage disable protection prayers/curses on hit (caused by direct hits) and a 5x5 gas cloud that starts dealing damage starting at 800 and increasing in intervals of 400 to 2,000 damage every few ticks.

Death Mark and Storm Shards can be helpful in ending the encounter faster before all stun immunity and damage mitigating defensives are all used up, but are not necessary.

## Trivia

• The name is likely a reference to the martial arts technique used to knock an opponent's legs out from under them.

achievements.description: Defeat Vorago without anyone hiding behind a waterfall during stage 4.
achievements.wikiSummary: Dry as a Bone is an achievement that requires the player to defeat Vorago without anyone hiding behind a waterfall during phase 4.
achievements.wikiText:
Dry as a Bone is an achievement that requires the player to defeat Vorago without anyone hiding behind a waterfall during phase 4.

## Strategy

Vorago can use his 'Waterfall' attack during phase 4 in normal mode, or phase 9 in hard mode. He will always start these phases by placing a protective waterfall in one of the four corners of the arena. Players have around 10 seconds (reduced in hard mode) to get to the waterfall and stand behind it, to avoid taking damage.

This achievement requires that for every waterfall, no player stands behind it. If the kill takes longer than the minimum 3 waterfalls, then each additional waterfall must be avoided as well. Each waterfall deals around 8,000 hard typeless damage and bypasses defensive abilities, so the only way to mitigate the damage is with a powerburst of vitality or Transfigure.

By default all players are eligible for this achievement, and it is only once any player stands behind a waterfall to avoid the damage that the message You have failed: Dry as a Bone appears and the achievement is no longer awarded.

## Achievement Set

Completing this achievement in a Hard Mode Vorago instance is one of the requirements for the Vorago (HM) (unorthodox) grandmaster achievement.

achievements.name: Extinction Event
achievements.description: Defeat the Rex Matriarchs, Pthentraken, Orikalka, and Rathis, all within 5 seconds of each other. Can only be completed in a solo instance.
achievements.wikiSummary: Extinction Event is an achievement that requires the player to defeat the Rex Matriarchs - Pthentraken, Orikalka, and Rathis - all within 5 seconds of each other.
achievements.wikiText:
Extinction Event is an achievement that requires the player to defeat the Rex Matriarchs - Pthentraken, Orikalka, and Rathis - all within 5 seconds of each other.

This achievement can only be completed in a private solo instance.

## Strategy

Similar to the They All Fell Down achievement for the Dagannoth Kings, players should attempt to lower the life points of the three matriarchs to 3,000 or below before attempting to defeat them. Use of cinderbane gloves or weapon poison should be avoided as it may cause a matriarch to die prematurely or unexpectedly. From this point, players should attempt to kill at least one of the matriarchs with a damage-over-time effect before finishing the other matriarch(s) with a strong attack such as an enhanced ability or special attack.

Due to the high defence of the matriarchs and the requirement to utilise all combat styles, players should bring hybrid armour like augmented Anima Core of Sliske so that they do not have to focus on switching their armour.

• Lower the life points of a matriarch down to less than 3,000 LP and then return over the entrance rubble at the lobby area.
• This will cause the matriarch to stop targeting the player and return to her section of the arena, but will not reset her life points. Players may still be occasionally attacked or targeted if they are on the tile immediately adjacent to the rubble obstacle, so they should move further back into the room.
• Lower each other matriarch's life points pool in the same way.
• Draw all three matriarchs together to make it easier to finish them all within the timeframe. Example: Run from Pthentraken's area across the arena into Rathis' melee distance, attracting Orikalka's attention along the way.

### Finishing with tribrid

Place each weapon into an action bar slot, keybinding each slot and additionally ensuring action bar binding is set up for each style. This saves time in switching between styles.

A good attack rotation to finish the matriarchs from this position:

• Corruption Shot on Pthentraken
• Corruption Blast or Wild Magic on Orikalka
• Barge or Greater Barge into Rathis, followed by a strong ability such as Punish or Hurricane if she is still alive after the Barge

Another example of an attack rotation to finish off the matriarchs:

• Dismember on Rathis
• Corruption Shot on Pthentraken
• Wild Magic on Orikalka

If the third matriarch enters her death animation while the first matriarch has not despawned from her death animation yet, players will successfully complete the achievement. It will only display as unlocked when the third matriarch despawns from her death animation.

Deathtouched dart does not work for this achievement.

### Finishing with Necromancy

Necromancy has very low affinity against all three Matriarchs, so it deals heavily reduced damage, however any amount of necromancy damage will instakill a matriarch if they are Death Marked and below 30,000 life points.

In this strategy, each matriarch has Invoke Death applied to them before their health is then lowered, which is done using the style that they are weak to. It is very important not to hit them with any necromancy damage after they have been marked. They do not need to be lowered to 3,000 LP, as any value below 30,000 will work. The higher life points makes this method safer from accidentally over-damaging and killing a matriarch.

To finish off the matriarchs, they must all be drawn together as before and then hit with any necromancy ability. As adrenaline is not required to deal the finishing damage, defensive such as Barricade may be useful. The deaths can occur simultaneously if Threads of Fate is used, although this is not necessary to complete the achievement.

Alternative method: First, bring all three Matriarchs one by one under 30,000 life points. Then draw all of them close together and use Invoke Death on each one, or even better Threads of Fate and then Invoke Death, as Threads of Fate will apply Invoke Death on all three Matriarchs at once.

achievements.wikiText:
Feeling a Little Venomous Today is an achievement that requires the player to defeat Rathis after stopping her from healing during her 'Poison absorption' attack.

This achievement can only be completed in a private, solo instance (max 1 player).

The player must absorb both pools of poison entirely before Rathis attempts to heal from them. Players must also have some type of antipoison active. She must stay alive long enough to attempt to channel the heal, otherwise it will not grant credit for this achievement.

## Strategy

• Drink a potion with antipoison effects (such as Antipoison, Antipoison+ or Antipoison++). You will be unable to absorb all the poison in time without a potion.
• Wait for Rathis to shoot out pools of poison.
• Stand in each of the poison pools to completely absorb the poison. This takes approximately 20 ticks (12s) for each pool. The poison effects on the ground must also completely disappear.
• Wait until Rathis performs her poison absorption attack (this is indicated by a roar).
• Kill Rathis to obtain the achievement.

achievements.name: Flipping the Script
achievements.description: Defeat TzKal-Zuk in hard mode in a single run after defeating all Igneous minions in reverse order during his 'Infernal Rain' attack in wave 18.
achievements.wikiSummary: Flipping the Script is an achievement that requires the player to defeat TzKal-Zuk in hard mode in a single run after defeating all Igneous minions in reverse order during his 'Infernal Rain' attack in wave 18. achievements.wikiText:
Flipping the Script is an achievement that requires the player to defeat TzKal-Zuk in hard mode in a single run after defeating all Igneous minions in reverse order during his 'Infernal Rain' attack in wave 18. The player is not eligible to complete this achievement if checkpoints are used.

## Strategy

During the Igneous Rain mechanic, Zuk will summon a melee, ranged and then magic minion in that order. Therefore, the player must kill them from magic, ranged and melee. They have the same health values as in normal mode and are dealt with the same way as usual.

Handling minions

• Mage minion: Stand within its shield dome.
• Ranged minion: Use a damaging enhanced or ultimate ability with Ranged or Magic. Alternatively with Necromancy, use Bloat or Finger of Death with Necrosis stacks. Save the ultimates for Zuk.
• Melee minion: Use stuns.

Ideally, the player should keep the ranger and melee minions' health around 5,000 and their reset threshold is not full. The minions will heal around 5,000 every few ticks if their removal trigger is not removed. Since the mage is first, the player should not have to worry about them. Players using conjures should be careful as they may deal too much damage and kill them.

The player will have roughly 15 seconds after the mage spawns before Zuk's instant kill goes off, which is a hard instant kill. As the mage is a hard NPC, the player should stand behind the mage in order to get the melee and range minions closer.

Flow State is an achievement that requires the player to defeat Raksha, the Shadow Colossus after using the correct protection prayer against all of his basic attacks.

## Strategy

Raksha will always close the distance on his main target and uses all three combat styles.

By default, the player targeted by Raksha should have a melee prayer active, as his melee attack is the fastest (although still slow enough to react to). The ranged attack consists of spiked barbs and the magic attack an orb of shadow energy.

Even if the attack is mitigated by defensive abilities or spells like Disruption Shield, the attack must still be prayed against.

## Trivia

• The name is likely a reference to the psychology of being in the "flow state", also known as being "in the zone", which is the mental state in which a person is fully immersed and focused in an activity.

achievements.description: Defeat Telos, the Warden at 100% or higher enrage after charging and using all fonts in phase 5.
achievements.wikiSummary: This achievement is part of a chain.
achievements.wikiText:
This achievement is part of a chain.

The chain is: Fonts of All Knowledge: I and II.

Fonts of All Knowledge I is an achievement that requires the player to defeat Telos, the Warden at 100% or higher enrage after charging and using all fonts in phase 5.

## Strategy

Each font can only be activated after Telos has performed at least 27 or 29 auto-attacks alongside two special attacks, as it is when Telos attempts to use its instant kill bomb.

The attack rotation in phase 5 consists of:

• Golems
• 10 auto-attacks
• Strong virus
• 17 auto-attacks
• Instant kill bomb
• 2 auto-attacks
• Loops from top

It is recommended to let Telos absorb from the green stream, as it provides it increased attack speed, as players would be waiting over a minute otherwise.

Before each bomb attack, Telos will spawn six anima-golems of the corresponding font to be used later. Only four of them need to be killed within range of the depleted anima font. At 100% enrage, the golems have 4,500 health.

infobox.Description: Defeat Telos, the Warden at 100% or higher enrage after charging and using all fonts in phase 5.

Fonts of All Knowledge II is an achievement that requires the player to defeat Telos, the Warden at 1,000% or higher enrage after charging and using all fonts in phase 5.

## Strategy

Follow the same method as its preceding achievement. At 1000% enrage, the anima-golems will have 24,750 health. The task is best completed with Necromancy; Threads of Fate, combined with Soul Sap and Volley of Souls and one other ability should be more than enough to kill the golems instantly. Make sure to use defensives while killing the golems, as both Telos and the golems will hit significantly harder.

This reduces Masuta the Ascended's magic attack in the final phase, and as players will have no stacks when completing this achievement, it will deal heavy damage even through prayer.

When going for this achievement, focus on only killing the water spouts on top of the stairs or at the bottom of the stairs. You can place yourself far enough away so that the remaining water spouts can't reach you with their magic attacks. You can then focus on switching protection prayers.

achievements.description: Defeat all 4 black hands, within 10 seconds after defeating the first, during the Black Stone Dragon fight.
achievements.wikiSummary: Four in Hand is an achievement that requires the player to defeat all 4 black hands, within 10 seconds after defeating the first, during the Black Stone Dragon fight in the Dragonkin Laboratory.
achievements.wikiText:
Four in Hand is an achievement that requires the player to defeat all 4 black hands, within 10 seconds after defeating the first, during the Black Stone Dragon fight in the Dragonkin Laboratory.

This achievement can be completed in story mode as well as in normal mode.

As the hands have very high defence, it is recommended to leave all of them at 4,000 health before killing them off for a group attempt.

For a solo attempt of this achievement, the ideal setup is to:

• Use story mode to reduce incoming damage by 90%.
• Use a ranged weapon with an attack range of 9, such as noxious longbow.
• Stand on top of the Black Stone Dragon, which allows every black hand to be attacked without moving.
• Stack buffs that increase accuracy, such as overloads and superior scrimshaw of ranging, to reduce the chance of missed hits on the black hands.
• Have low strength ammunition such as bronze arrows as switches to reduce the health of each black hand to below 2,000 without killing it.

If everything goes right, this setup should result in 4 black hands with less than 2,000 health, which can all be killed in 1 hit without needing to move; the achievement will then be shown as completed when the last black hand dies (no need to kill the Black Stone Dragon). If something goes wrong, another attempt can be made simply by teleporting out and restarting the Black Stone Dragon fight.

infobox.Description: Defeat all 4 black hands, within 10 seconds after defeating the first, during the Black Stone Dragon fight.

achievements.name: Four Times The Fun
achievements.description: Defeat Amascut, the Devourer after intercepting her attack on all four of the Menaphite altars at once in phase 5.
achievements.wikiSummary: Four Times The Fun is an achievement that requires the player to defeat Amascut, the Devourer after intercepting her attack on all four of the Menaphite altars at once in phase 5.
achievements.wikiText:
Four Times The Fun is an achievement that requires the player to defeat Amascut, the Devourer after intercepting her attack on all four of the Menaphite altars at once in phase 5.

## Requirements

This achievement requires that Amascut targets all 4 statues in phase 5 with her green projectiles, and the player must intercept them all. Every 10 seconds, she targets each fragment that has at least some charge on it, via its statue. Any enrage can be used for this achievement, so it is recommended that players complete it in normal mode.

After intercepting all 4 projectiles, the message You are now eligible for: Four Times The Fun. appears to show eligibility.

## Strategy

This achievement does not require that all 4 fragments are fully charged, only that they are partially charged so that Amascut will target them. In normal mode, the recommended method to do this is to first fully charge one of the fragments so that Tumeken can be reformed. Then, each of the remaining fragments can be partially charged so that Amascut starts to throw all 4 green projectiles. Then each player in the team that needs the achievement can take it in turns to intercept all 4 projectiles at once, and when everyone who needs it has their eligibility message then Tumeken can be reformed and the fight concluded.

While intercepting all 4 projectiles it is recommended to use a defensive such as Reflect or Debilitate to reduce the damage taken.

achievements.description: Defeat Vorago without Vorago moving and without anyone moving during the 'Vitalis' stage.
achievements.wikiSummary: Freeze Frame is an achievement that requires the player to defeat Vorago without Vorago moving and without anyone moving during the 'Vitalis' stage.
achievements.wikiText:
Freeze Frame is an achievement that requires the player to defeat Vorago without Vorago moving and without anyone moving during the 'Vitalis' stage.

## Strategy

Vorago's Vitalis attack happens in phase 3 in normal mode when the rotation is Vitalis. In hard mode it is phase 5 for all rotations.

This achievement requires that the players do not move at all, and that Vorago also does not move. Players should stand in a position such that they are adjacent to Vorago when he spawns. Standing under Vorago's spawn area will force the player out, which fails the achievement, and standing too far away can cause the Vitalis minions to block line of sight if they move between the player and Vorago, which will force movement and fail the achievement. Vorago may also move when he attempts a melee attack if his target is not in melee distance, which fails the achievement.

By default all players are eligible for this achievement, and it is only once any player moves for any reason (after Vorago spawns) that the message You have failed: Freeze Frame appears and the achievement is no longer awarded.

## Achievement Set

Completing this achievement in a Hard Mode Vorago instance is one of the requirements for the Vorago (HM) (perfect) grandmaster achievement.

achievements.name: Ful of Energy but Nowhere to Go
achievements.wikiTitle: Ful of Energy but Nowhere to Go
achievements.description: Defeat TzKal-Zuk in hard mode in a single run without moving after attacking the 'Conduit of Ful' in wave 18.
achievements.wikiSummary: Ful of Energy but Nowhere to Go is an achievement that requires the player to defeat TzKal-Zuk in hard mode in a single run without moving after attacking the Conduit of Ful in wave 18. The player is not eligible to complete this achievement if checkpoints are used.
achievements.wikiText:
Ful of Energy but Nowhere to Go is an achievement that requires the player to defeat TzKal-Zuk in hard mode in a single run without moving after attacking the Conduit of Ful in wave 18. The player is not eligible to complete this achievement if checkpoints are used.

## Strategy

The player will not be allowed to move by any means after attacking the conduit.

The conduit has 50,000 health and Zuk has 100,000 health when this phase is initiated. While the conduit is active with health, Zuk will launch fireballs at the player in a 7x7 AoE centred on them when used, which deals up to 9,000 soft typeless damage - It is mandatory to mitigate these. It is also possible to delay the next fireball in sequence with proper phasing, which must be done by depleting the conduit on the tick before the fireball shatters on the arena. This will delay Zuk's next attack by 6 or 7 ticks, which is more than enough to deal lots of damage without worrying about the fireballs.

When the conduit reaches 0 health, Zuk will take 20,000 damage and prepare a retaliatory fireball that deals 15,000 soft typeless damage after a short duration, and the conduit becomes superheated, taking 50% less damage while this fireball is being charged. Deal as much damage as possible to the conduit during this time, as allowing even one fireball to deal damage will likely kill the player. Using Death Mark on the conduit will help reduce overall damage needed, as it will activate upon reaching 10,000 health or less. The use of Barricade and Immortality are essentially mandatory, the former especially with malletops to increase its duration. Necromancy, coupled with Zemouregal's nexus and Greater Bone Shield, will allow for 12 seconds of Barricade. Other ways to survive the blast include Reflect, Resonance/Divert, Disruption Shield, a powerburst of vitality, Shield Dome, and one of the Spirit shields that has a passive to reduce damage taken in exchange for prayer points as a panic option. The Phantom Guardian conjure will also help reduce the damage taken.

It is recommended to bring five pieces of obsidian equipment, excluding the obsidian kiteshield, to equip for the Conduit of Ful, as the pieces will grant a total of 45% damage reduction from the fireballs that are launched. This can be increased a further 10% by donating tokkul to the Fight Cauldron coffer, for a total of 55% damage reduction, reducing their damage to around 4950, which can be outhealed with brews and blubberfish during the first four segments.

Bring a pack mammoth with its scrolls. When the Beast of Burden's inventory is empty summon a hellhound familiar, as the hellhound takes 20% of the damage that would have been inflicted to the player, extending the player's remaining food.

In the scenario that a player is using five pieces of obsidian equipment and a hellhound familiar, their damage reduction with no abilities involved means they can reduce the 9,000 fireball damage down to under 3,000 damage per hit.

achievements.name: Gas Detector
achievements.description: Defeat Vorago without anyone being hit by a Gas Cloud attack during the 'Green Bomb' stage.
achievements.wikiSummary: Gas Detector is an achievement that requires the player to participate in a successful encounter against Vorago without anyone being hit by a Gas Cloud attack.
achievements.wikiText:
Gas Detector is an achievement that requires the player to participate in a successful encounter against Vorago without anyone being hit by a Gas Cloud attack.

## Strategy

Vorago can use his green bomb attack during phases 3, 4, and 5 in normal mode, but only when the rotation is Green Bomb. Despite the description, it is also required to interact with this mechanic when it appears in phases 4 and 5. In hard mode, the green bomb occurs in phase 6, and also in phases 9, 10, and 11 if the rotation is set to Green Bomb, or phase 10 if the rotation is Ceiling Collapse.

When the green bomb attack is used, it first travels to a location on the ground and places a gas cloud that damages players and drains run energy. This achievement simply requires that no player takes gets hit by any gas cloud. The clouds last until the end of the phase, so if there is a gas cloud covering a waterfall in phase 4 then it will be required to mitigate the damage without using the waterfall. Essentially, phase 4 is the only major roadblock for this achievement, since having enough damage to power past phase 3 will prevent the bomb from landing and making a cloud. In phase 5 normal mode, or 10 and 11 hard mode, the bomb will always land outside of the playable arena, thus preventing the gas from forming at all.

By default all players are eligible for this achievement, and it is only once any player gets hit by a cloud that the message You have failed: Gas Detector appears and the achievement is no longer awarded. Thus completing a kill where one or more ceiling collapse mechanics are skipped, such as by ending phase 3 before the second ceiling collapse happens, will not invalidate the achievement.

## Achievement set

Completing this achievement in a hard mode Vorago instance is one of the requirements for the Vorago (HM) (perfect) grandmaster achievement.

achievements.wikiSummary: Get Shredded is an achievement that is completed by defeating The Crassian Leviathan inside The Shadow Reef after having taken at least 30,000 damage from its sweep attack.
achievements.wikiText:
Get Shredded is an achievement that is completed by defeating The Crassian Leviathan inside The Shadow Reef after having taken at least 30,000 damage from its sweep attack.

The achievement tracks damage before damage modifiers are applied. This means that each hit will count for 4,000 damage, even if it is reduced by abilities, such as Debilitate and even Barricade. Conversely, increasing the damage you take (e.g. from Berserk) will not speed up the achievement. Thus exactly 8 hits are required to be taken.

The safest way is to stand in front of the Leviathan's head while using Barricade with a tier 90 shield that has the Turtling perk, which is more than enough to register most, if not all, of the sweep's damage, as it has a base damage of 4,000 per tick. As it is soft typeless damage, Debilitate and Reflect can also work with a tier 90 shield, as it reduces the damage of the attack to roughly 1,000 per tick.

This achievement can only be completed in normal mode.

achievements.wikiText:
Glutton for Punishment is an achievement that requires the player to allow the Corporeal Beast to devour seven specific familiars. This can only be completed in a solo instance.

The achievement does not require the player to summon all familiars in the same encounter, nor does the Beast need to be killed. The familiars that need to be eaten are:

## Walkthrough

### Obtaining the evil turnip pouch

Try purchasing the evil turnip pouch or its ingredients on the Grand Exchange.

If it is unobtainable from other players or the players wish to craft it manually, they may follow these steps.

• To obtain evil turnip seed with a higher chance of success:
• Kill the giant mole to obtain a few pieces of mole claw and mole skin.
• Use the option Exchange mole bits on Wyson the gardener at Falador Park to obtain bird's nest (cheap seeds).
• Opening the nests has a chance to obtain evil turnip seed.
• Head to Draynor Manor and plant these seeds at the evil turnip patch.
• Harvest the patch to obtain evil turnip and cut it with a knife to create carved evil turnip.
• Create the evil turnip pouch from the items.

### Obtaining the pack pig pouch

Since this item is untradeable, you will have to craft it manually.

• Head to the Falador farm north of Port Sarim (see map).
• Complete the Bringing Home the Bacon quest.
• Visit Eli inside the Storm cellar.
• Make sure the pig machine is set to pack pig machine, otherwise you will receive the wrong pouches.
• Select the Claim Reward option on Eli, and ask him "Can I get some trained pig familiars?".
• Eli will send 10 pack pig pouch to your bank.
• If the above method does not work, you will have to use the pack pig machine to create them.

### Obtaining the other pouches

Obtain the following pouches:

• Dreadfowl pouch (requires 4 ) can be created from raw chicken
• Thorny snail pouch (requires 13 ) can be created from thin snail
• Evil turnip pouch (requires 42 ) can be created from carved evil turnip
• War tortoise pouch (requires 67 ) can be created from tortoise shell
• Fruit bat pouch (requires 69 ) can be created from banana
• Granite lobster pouch (requires 74 ) can be created from granite (500g)

### The fight

• Restore your Summoning points and carry some Summoning potions.
• Enter the Corporeal Beast's Lair in a single private instance, ensuring the max players is set to 1.
• Summon the familiars one at a time and wait for them to be consumed. This does not have to be done in a single encounter.
• Dreadfowl pouch
• Thorny snail pouch
• Evil turnip pouch
• War tortoise pouch
• Fruit bat pouch
• Granite lobster pouch
• Pack pig pouch

## Trivia

• The idiom 'glutton for punishment' refers to a person who often undertakes difficult or unpleasant tasks.

## Strategy

Throughout the fight, the four gongs on each side of the arena can be repaired. It is only worthwhile to repair these gongs near the end of the fight when you can guarantee that they won't be damaged again.

Multiple players can repair one gong to speed up the process, but it is important to not ring any of the gongs after they have been repaired or the achievement will be failed.

achievements.name: Good Enough for a Goblin
achievements.description: Defeat Corporeal Beast using only a bronze spear. Can only be completed in a solo instance.
achievements.wikiSummary: Good Enough for a Goblin is an achievement that requires the player to defeat the Corporeal Beast while wielding a bronze spear.
achievements.wikiText:
Good Enough for a Goblin is an achievement that requires the player to defeat the Corporeal Beast while wielding a bronze spear.

## Strategy

The spear must be used throughout the entire kill, not just for the finishing blow. The achievement is tracked from the moment the Beast spawns. If it takes any type of damage outside of a bronze spear (with some exceptions listed below), the player is automatically disqualified from the achievement. This achievement can only be completed in a solo instance.

Some sources of additional damage outside of the spear's weak base damage will not cause disqualification. Weapon poison, cinderbane gloves, kwuarm incense sticks, brawler's blood necklace, scrimshaws (e.g. scrimshaw of vampyrism), armour spikes (alloy), and perks such as Crackling can improve chances of killing the beast without breaking the rules for the achievement. Additionally, primal feasts may be helpful as they heal a total of 10,000 life points. Special attacks in an Essence of Finality amulet can be used. A Kinetic cyclone can also be used, as can reflect damage, such as from the curses Deflect Magic/Deflect Melee.

However, other sources of damage are known to disqualify the player from earning the achievement. Abyssal armour spikes and its variants cannot be used, as well as dreadnips. God books also cannot be used, however Erethdor's grimoire can.

## Trivia

• Even though the achievement can only be done alone, the disqualification message that appears will state that someone else caused the player to be disqualified.

achievements.wikiText:
Gorilla Warfare is an achievement that requires the player to defeat Nakatra, Devourer Eternal in hard mode after defeating both Shadowsands gorilla akhs.

## Strategy

In hard mode, the gorilla akhs will have 150,000 health. Damage caused to the gorilla akhs will remain while the player is outside of the Shadowsands, and they do not respawn if killed, so the gorilla akhs do not have to be killed in a single cycle. They are placed at the sides of the Shadowsands and stationary, so they cannot both be hit simultaneously with AoE abilities.

During the mechanic, the player must also escape the Shadowsands by interacting with the soul storm to release two Shadowsands feline akhs, who possess 22,500 health each. Players are only given 30 seconds in the Shadowsands before the Avatar of Amascut instant kills them, so they should lure the feline akhs to one of the gorillas and use AoE abilities. Death Marking the gorilla akhs are recommended so they will die after falling below 30,000 health. Players should keep an ideal damage rotation for the gorillas while also ensuring they maintain sufficient DPS at Nakatra; an experienced player should be able to subdue both gorillas within two or three cycles.

## Trivia

• The title of this achievement is a reference to guerrilla warfare.

infobox.Description: Defeat Nakatra, Devourer Eternal in hard mode after defeating both Shadowsands gorilla akhs.

achievements.wikiText:
Hand in Hand is an achievement that requires the player to participate in a successful encounter against the black stone dragon without anyone in the encounter being hit by her "Grasping Hands" attack.

## Strategy

During phase 2, a few game ticks after the black hands hit the players with a slow-moving magic attack, a line of grasping hands extends from them in the direction of the targeted players. The hands advance at a walking pace and deal area damage in their game square for approximately 5 seconds. There are a few safe spots available if using ranged or magic, but necromancy and melee combat styles need to pay closer attention to the timing and move away from the path of the hands.

achievements.description: Defeat the Ambassador without allowing him to heal from his 'Circle of Black Hands' attack.
achievements.wikiSummary: Hand To Heal is an achievement that requires the player to defeat The Ambassador without allowing him to heal from his 'Circle of Black Hands' attack.
achievements.wikiText:
Hand To Heal is an achievement that requires the player to defeat The Ambassador without allowing him to heal from his 'Circle of Black Hands' attack.

A player can stand directly underneath the Ambassador to prevent any heals from getting through. If the Ambassador is killed before the hands begin to cast, it will also successfully complete this achievement.

In solo, one should go underneath the Ambassador before the hands spawning. After the first hand slams, one can choose to come out and walk around the Ambassador in clock-wise fashion following the slamming hands. The other option would be to stay underneath and spam click the floor to avoid coming out while manually casting abilities. The last option would be to stay underneath and damage the Ambassador only via conjures, familiars and god book procs while maintaining health via prayer, food and defensives.

infobox.Description: Defeat the Ambassador without allowing him to heal from his 'Circle of Black Hands' attack.

achievements.description: Defeat the Crassian Leviathan after allowing it to fully regenerate from below half health.
achievements.wikiSummary: Harassing the Crassian is an achievement that requires the player to defeat the Crassian Leviathan inside the Shadow Reef after allowing it to fully regenerate from below half health. The Crassian Leviathan must be damaged to under 190,000 life points, at which point the player must stop attacking and wait for it to heal itself back to 380,000, ideally avoiding damage and using a shield to minimise damage. After this is done, the Leviathan must be defeated.
achievements.wikiText:
Harassing the Crassian is an achievement that requires the player to defeat the Crassian Leviathan inside the Shadow Reef after allowing it to fully regenerate from below half health. The Crassian Leviathan must be damaged to under 190,000 life points, at which point the player must stop attacking and wait for it to heal itself back to 380,000, ideally avoiding damage and using a shield to minimise damage. After this is done, the Leviathan must be defeated.

To make the Leviathan heal itself faster, do not have weapon poison applied or have cinderbane gloves equipped. Do not have offensive familiars summoned, either. In a trio encounter, the Leviathan heals 9,000 life points per heal, reducing the amount of time needed to fully heal itself. Players can start with cinderbane gloves equipped, but then change to other gloves as soon as the poison is applied to make it heal slower during the initial part of the fight. When the Crassian Leviathan has healed back to 380,000, weapon poison and cinderbane gloves can then be used to finish it.

If using Necromancy, unequip your soulbound lantern or skull lantern to dismiss the conjures. This will prevent the Crassian Leviathan from taking damage from the Putrid Zombie's passive ability.

This achievement can only be completed in normal mode.

achievements.wikiSummary: Healing Denied is an achievement that requires the player to defeat Nakatra, Devourer Eternal in hard mode without letting her heal Nefthys, the Split Soul.
achievements.wikiText:
Healing Denied is an achievement that requires the player to defeat Nakatra, Devourer Eternal in hard mode without letting her heal Nefthys, the Split Soul.

## Strategy

Nefthys has 90,000 health in hard mode. For every player present in the arena, two Nefthys appear when Nakatra reaches 40% of her life points. The player must stand within melee range in order to deal full damage to Nefthys.

Death Mark helps kill all Nefthys as soon as possible. Players should use an ultimate attack rotation during this phase even though it will decrease their damage output in the Shadowsands phase.

Nakatra will attempt to heal all Nefthys in the arena roughly 20 seconds after they are summoned. Nakatra's attack rotation in phase 3 involves:

• Summon Nefthys/Heal Nefthys
• Soulfire Crosswave
• Soulfire Wave
• Soulfire Crosswave
• Soulfire Wave
• Repeat

Players will fail the achievement if Nakatra initiates the healing, even if Nefthys is killed before the heal reaches them.

achievements.wikiTitle: Healing in the Name of Bleeds

achievements.wikiSummary: Healing in the Name of Bleeds is an achievement that requires the player to defeat Nex solo after allowing her to fully heal during her Blood phase.
achievements.wikiText:
Healing in the Name of Bleeds is an achievement that requires the player to defeat Nex solo after allowing her to fully heal during her Blood phase.

## Strategy

Nex must heal 80,000 health in order to restore back to full. During the blood phase, Nex will heal from the following:

• Being attacked during her siphon animation
• Being attacked with bleeds of any sort for the duration of the phase (excluding Puncture, Bloat, and the Dragon Rider amulet's combust effect, which still deal damage normally)
• Her magic auto-attacks
• Siphoning off blood reavers

By constantly using bleeds, attacking Nex during her siphon and letting her heal fully off blood reavers, Nex should be able to return to full health within one or two cycles, depending on the player's damage output.

infobox.Description: Defeat Nex solo, after allowing her to fully heal during her Blood phase.

achievements.wikiText:
Heatproof is an achievement that requires the player to defeat Zemouregal & Vorkath in hard mode without using any dragonfire protection.

## Strategy

Unlike other dragons' dragonfire, Vorkath's dragonfire is unique in that it is dealt as magic damage which can be mitigated via defensive abilities, and can also miss. However, it is best to keep health as high as possible, as the dragonfire can deal a lot of damage if it does hit, especially if Vorkath has been empowered by an empowering zombie.

In group kills, one can re-enter the fight after dying and still get credit for this achievement.

This achievement fails if any player in the instance gets hit by Vorkath's dragonfire while using any dragonfire protection.

achievements.wikiSummary: Here is my Handle is an achievement that requires the player to defeat the Sanctum Guardian in the Temple of Aminishi after being hit by her water spout 10 times.
achievements.wikiText:
Here is my Handle is an achievement that requires the player to defeat the Sanctum Guardian in the Temple of Aminishi after being hit by her water spout 10 times.

The achievement counts each hit via raw damage, as opposed to times that the water spout was used and did damage per use. A quick method to get the achievement is to follow along the path of the spout on the north-west side while using Barricade with a tier 90 shield that has the Turtling 3 perk, which will protect the player from life point damage while registering successful hits. As it is soft typeless damage, Debilitate and Reflect can also work with a tier 90 shield, as it reduces the damage of the attack to roughly 1,000 per tick. This method can allow the player to meet the requirement in only a few usages of the water spout. The Sanctum Guardian must still be defeated once this requirement is met, though; using a fishy treat or defeating her normally will allow the achievement to be completed. Using a deathtouched dart will not complete the achievement.

This achievement can only be completed in normal mode.

## Trivia

• The achievement name is a reference to the song "I'm a Little Teapot".

achievements.description: Defeat Vorago without allowing him to move forward in stage 5.
achievements.wikiSummary: Hold It Right There is an achievement that requires the player to participate in a successful encounter against Vorago without allowing him to move forward in the last phase, or last two phases in hard mode.
achievements.wikiText:
Hold It Right There is an achievement that requires the player to participate in a successful encounter against Vorago without allowing him to move forward in the last phase, or last two phases in hard mode.

## Strategy

Vorago has a unique damage mechanic in phase 5 (phases 10 and 11 in hard mode) where he moves forward and backward depending on the amounts of damage done to him and done by him to players. As he damages players, he moves forwards, and as players damage him, he moves backward. Some forms of damage mitigation can prevent him from moving forward, and making him move backward briefly delays his next attack.

This achievement requires players to overwhelm Vorago with damage such that he never gets a chance to move forward even one step during this mechanic. As there is no group size limit for this achievement, it can be completed easily by bringing a large number of players and simply brute forcing the damage check. Alternatively, a smaller number of players with an effective damage burst rotation can repeatedly force Vorago to move backward such that he never gets a chance to attack. Ensuring that the maul of omens is ready to be used as soon as Vorago reaches the back of the arena will reduce the amount of time that he is needed to be held there.

Standing out of melee range, ideally by using a halberd or non-melee style, is recommended for this achievement, as Vorago dealing any amount of damage is more than enough to allow him to move forward, invalidating the achievement. The only way to prevent Vorago from advancing if he does manage to launch an attack is by using Barricade, and as Vorago's magic attacks deal area damage, Intercept is additionally required.

Using Disruption Shield and Barricade will prevent Vorago's attacks from causing pushback. At the very least, have Disruption Shield active before the phase starts.

By default all players are eligible for this achievement, and it is only once Vorago takes a step forward in phase 5 (or 10 or 11 in hard mode) that the message You have failed: Hold It Right There appears and the achievement is no longer awarded. If Vorago steps forward and at the same time the player or players push Vorago back on the last tile and quickly mauls, this achievement will be completed despite Vorago moved a step forward.

How Do I Clear This? is an achievement that requires the player to defeat Vorago without anyone clearing his 'Destroy Tank' ability.

## Strategy

Bleeds are applied during phases 2 and 5 on all rotations. It will also be applied during phase 3 if the current rotation is Vitalis, and phase 4 for every rotation except The End (purple bombs). It is required to deal with the bleeds appropriately during any phase in which they appear. In hard mode, bleeds can appear in phases 2, 5, 9 (except during The End rotation), 10 (only during The End rotation), or 11 (only during Vitalis rotation).

During the bleed sequence, Vorago will apply five instances of the bleed to his target. If the bleed is not cleared, the next hit will deal 6,000 damage instead. A team size of five is recommended for this achievement, with players provoking Vorago after each bleed application so he focuses on them instead for his next bleed. An alternate strategy is to have one player take all 5 bleeds while under the effects of Intercept from another player who has Barricaded, although it should be noted that the five attacks occur over a span of 15 seconds, thus requiring another player to use Intercept unless the primary intercepter has all the perks needed to prolong Barricade (a tier 90 shield with Turtling 4 and a double malletops perk).

Regardless of the strategy to prevent deaths due to bleeds, it is important the the bleeds are not cleared after the attack is over until they time out naturally. Freedom should not be used, and players should not walk too far away from Vorago. This is particularly important in phase 2, when the gravity orbs must be interacted with shortly after the bleeds attack ends but while the debuff persists. If a player moves too far away from Vorago to interact with a gravity orb, the achievement will fail.

In phase 5, Vorago gains Provoke Immune, though the bleed sequences are reduced to three times per attack. Unlike the previous phases, the damage dealt is based on where the player was when the bleed was inflicted, so players should not move too far as this may accidentally clear the bleed. All players should keep at least 8,000 health in the event of a double bleed.

By default all players are eligible for this achievement, and it is only once a bleed is cleared by any means (except it timing out) that the message You have failed: How Do I Clear This? appears and the achievement is no longer awarded. Thus completing a kill where one or more sets of bleeds are skipped, such as by Ceiling Collapse phase 4 bleed skips or ending phase 5 before bleeds happen, will not invalidate the achievement.

When he casts this spell, a wall of ghosts will spawn and move towards the player. Surge, Escape, or Dive all work well for avoiding them. If he summons diagonally, it will be harder to tell exactly which game squares the line is affecting, but a movement ability to get past them will still work fine. As an alternative, one may move past Rasial's initial spawn point and stand right next to platform he teleports to in phase 4. In that position the ghost walls will spawn right under the player, but will not deal any damage and (presumably) not register a hit, as long as the player does not move during phase 3.

Killing an incorrect rune gives a large hit of soft typeless damage, such that defensives can be used to reduce or avoid damage entirely. While Zamorak is charging the runes he does not attack, so Resonance or Disruption Shield can be used safely to avoid the damage without being sniped, however this will put them on cooldown. In the case of taking multiple cycles to complete phase 7, only one rune needs to be killed incorrectly. It does not need to be done on every cycle.

## Strategy

Vorago can use his "The End" attack during phases 3 and 4 in normal mode, but only when the rotation is The End. Despite the description, it is also required to interact with this mechanic when it appears in phase 4. In hard mode, The End occurs in phase 8, and also in phase 9 if the rotation is The End.

This achievement requires that every time Vorago begins The End, all bombs (blue, red, and purple) are released before he finishes the attack. The bombs are released by interacting with them in the quadrants of the arena, and the number of each bomb scales with the number of players in the instance. The blue bombs will deal magic damage that ignores the player's Devotion (but everything else works as normal), while the red bombs act the same as normal. The purple bomb will turn all into an explosive vitalis, working in a manner similar to the red bombs but dealing soft typeless rather than hard.

To block damage from the red bombs, a player could simply tank them with a powerburst of vitality, or be affected by Intercept while the interceptor uses Barricade to block all damage from the bombs.

By default, all players are eligible for this achievement, and it is only once a The End attack completes without all of the bombs being released that the message You have failed: I Wonder What These Do appears and the achievement is no longer awarded. Thus, completing a kill where phase 3 (or 8) is ended before The End attack finishes will not invalidate the achievement.

achievements.wikiText:
In a While, Crocodile is an achievement that requires the player to defeat Amascut, the Devourer in enrage mode without anyone defeating any modest crocodile demons.

## Requirements

In phase 2 of the Amascut fight, she will summon four crocodile minions. The first pair will spawn shortly after the phase begins, one coming from each of the pyramid doors on the east and west. The second pair will spawn shortly after the second fragment of Tumeken is brought from its side room into the main arena. All 4 of these crocodiles will automatically die off when phase 2 ends, which does not invalidate the achievement.

Amascut will also spawn 2 crocodiles at a time in phase 7 if she targets the Crondis statue, however these crocodiles will not die off.

This achievement requires that no player ever defeats a crocodile. They can be damaged by players, and that will not invalidate the achievement unless they die from it. Any enrage can be used for this achievement, so it is recommended that players complete it at 100% enrage, unless they are looking to complete the unorthodox achievement, which requires 2000% enrage.

This achievement is failed if a player defeats a crocodile at any time, which will display the message You have failed In a While, Crocodile: A Modest crocodile demon was defeated..

## Strategy

Since players cannot defeat the crocodiles, they must be kept alive. As the achievement is not invalidated by damaging the crocodiles, using deflection prayers is allowed.

### Phase 2

Since the crocodiles in phase 2 will die eventually, they only need to be tanked for the duration of the phase. While the crocodiles cannot be provoked, their aggression can be manipulated:

• A crocodile will aggro onto the player that is closest to it once it fully exits its spawn door.
• If the player that a crocodile is aggro'd onto enters a side room (or dies), then the crocodile will obtain the new closest player as a target.

The base tank can take aggro from the first pair of crocodiles when the other players enter the side rooms, but the second pair of crocodiles cannot be taken that way unless all players re-enter the side rooms. When the phase progresses to the point at which Amascut can be damaged, any player with the aggro of a crocodile should stand in such a place that the crocodiles are far enough from Amascut that any multi-target abilities will not reach the crocodiles. This is especially true of Death Skulls, which should only be used by players out of range of all crocodiles.

Players with the aggression of the crocodiles will want to prayer flick against their magic attacks, which they use when their adrenaline bar is full. Even through prayer, the magic attacks will drain adrenaline and apply an adrenaline-reducing debuff.

### Phase 7

Crocodiles are not guaranteed in phase 7, Amascut will only spawn 2 of them when she targets the Crondis statue. They will never despawn, so must be tanked for the rest of phase 7, and extra care taken to not damage them:

• Death Skulls should not be used at all if there are crocodiles present.
• Other area- or multi-target abilities should not be used, even basic abilities, to avoid damaging the crocodiles.

Alternatively, if Amascut calls the Crondis statue but the team does not provoke her toward it, then the crocodiles will not spawn. However, all players will take a large amount of damage that must be mitigated.

The team should prepare as well as they can by ending phase 6 with the minimum health possible, to make phase 7 as short as possible and minimise the time when the team may have to fight around the crocodiles. This is particularly problematic when attempting the unorthodox achievement, as Amascut will have at least 9,000,000 health for phase 7.

achievements.wikiText:
In the Nick of Time is an achievement that requires the player to defeat Amascut, the Devourer at 1,000% or higher enrage after depositing each of fragments of Tumeken when Amascut has less than 3 seconds until she uses her 'Devourer's Destruction' attack.

## Requirements

In phases 2 and 4 of the Amascut fight, players must deliver the fragments of Tumeken to their statues before the timer on her 'Devourer's Destruction' attack reaches zero, or else the players all are instakilled. This achievement requires that both fragments are deposited when there is less than 3 seconds remaining on the timer. It also requires that the enrage of the fight is at least 1000%, although completing it at 2000% is one of the requirements for the unorthodox achievement.

This achievement is failed if Amascut is stunned by a fragment in either phase 2 or 4 when there is more than 3 seconds remaining on the timer, which will display the message You have failed In the Nick of Time..

## Strategy

When picking up the fragment of Tumeken, there is a 30 second time limit before it returns to the chamber it came from. The players carrying the fragments should take it when there is between 30 and 25 seconds left before destruction and rush to their statue. There is a three tick delay between clicking the statue and Amascut being stunned by it, so the player should click the statue when the timer reads between 4.8 and 3 seconds remaining until destruction. Clicking the statue too late can result in being hit with the full instant kill. Conversely, clicking when the timer shows 5.4 or more will fail the achievement, as Amascut will be stunned before the 3 limit on the timer.

The black hole must actually hit you for it to count towards this achievement – standing out of its radius when it explodes will not count towards the achievement.

It is recommended to complete this achievement in trio mode so Kranon creates three black holes at once. To avoid taking damage, activate Barricade just before the timer bars above the black holes run out. Players will need to wait for Kranon to use the black hole special attack twice.

In a solo kill, players will have to cycle through Kranon's attacks multiple times, including the spinner special attack. Because of this, it is important not to use heavy hitting abilities on the Ambassador so as to not phase the boss too quickly. This also means placing the smoke in a location such as the outer edge of the arena where players are not at risk of stepping in it, resulting in unnecessary damage.

achievements.wikiText:
It's Coarse and Rough and Irritating is an achievement that requires the player to defeat Nakatra, Devourer Eternal without being sent to the Shadowsands more than once.

It is part of the Nakatra, Devourer Eternal (perfect) and Nakatra, Devourer Eternal (HM) (perfect) achievements.

## Strategy

Once the copies of Nefthys, the Split Soul are dealt with, the player should dump a death guard special alongside a five stack Volley of Souls to deal around 60,000 damage to Nakatra. There is a very small time frame after Nefthys is killed for this to occur, and mistiming the attacks will result in them dealing significantly reduced damage.

In the Shadowsands, gain 100% adrenaline, memorise the patterns and handle the blast accordingly. Nakatra will be stunned for 11.4 seconds after the barrage before she recovers and initiates Sanctum Shockwave and seven auto-attacks. Afterwards, she will use Obliterate, followed by three sets of hieroglyphs, one instance of soulfire waves and three more hieroglyphs before repeating the attack pattern again. This gives players around a minute or so to deal 320,000 damage.

In hard mode, an additional 160,000 damage is required. Given the shorter time frame after the blast, this results in less overall time given to deal the necessary damage.

## Trivia

• The name of the achievement is a direct quote from Star Wars Episode II: Attack of the Clones, in which Anakin Skywalker says to Padmé Amidala that he doesn't like sand, talking about his experience with sand on his desert home planet of Tatooine.

## Strategy

Vorago can only summon his Scopulus minions during phase 3 in normal mode when the rotation is Scopulus. In hard mode it is phase 4 for all rotations. Scopuli will spawn to the southwest and southeast respectively, with an additional to the north in hard mode.

Let all scopuli spawn and do not attack them until they stop moving, as trying to do so will result in a high chance for them to displace the player and invalidate the achievement. If one goes for a bomb tank, it is recommended they be provoked, or kill it off first.

Once the scopuli die, the player must remain still until the phase ends, or the achievement will fail. This will mean eating if Vorago lands near the player.

By default all players are eligible for this achievement, and it is only once any player moves for any reason (after the Scopuli spawn) that the message You have failed: Its Vision Is Based On Movement appears and the achievement is no longer awarded.

achievements.name: Legiones Beginner Speed Killer
achievements.description: Defeat any of the six Ascension Legiones solo in less than 00:30.
achievements.wikiSummary: Legiones Beginner Speed Killer is an achievement that requires the player to defeat any of the six Legiones solo in less than 30 seconds.
achievements.wikiText:
Legiones Beginner Speed Killer is an achievement that requires the player to defeat any of the six Legiones solo in less than 30 seconds.

## Strategy

If players use Necromancy to kill the Legiones, they can easily obtain this achivement. A rotation of Split Soul, Death Skulls, 5 stack Volley of Souls and Finger of Death should easily finish them off. Players can build stacks on the war dummies.

A legio has 30,000 health, which is divided into four intervals of 7,500 health each. A powerful ranged or necromancy weapon, along with Split Soul or the eldritch crossbow's special attack should be enough.

It is recommended to kill either Legio Primus, Legio Secundus or Legio Sextus for this achievement, as they have the least troublesome mechanics of the six.

A rotation of Split Soul, Death Skulls, 5 stack Volley of Souls and Finger of Death should easily finish them off. Players can build stacks on the war dummies. The timer starts as soon as the player enters the room, it is advised to Split Soul and prepare conjures prior to entering the room.

A legio has 30,000 health, which is divided into four intervals of 7,500 health each. A powerful ranged or necromancy weapon, along with Split Soul or the eldritch crossbow's special attack should be enough. A slayer task is also recommended for extra damage.

It is recommended to kill either Legio Primus, Legio Secundus or Legio Sextus for this achievement, as they have the least troublesome mechanics of the six.

achievements.wikiText:
Let the Poison In is an achievement that requires the player to defeat Raksha, the Shadow Colossus without expelling any poisonous shadow energy from his 'Mind Flay' attack.

## Strategy

During phase 2 and phase 3 when he locks the player in place and summons floating orbs, simply ignore the orbs and continue to damage Raksha. The player will take constant ticks of ~500 typeless damage for 8 seconds, after which Raksha will explode the orbs, dealing around 3,000 soft typeless damage for each orb not expelled. Using defensive abilities such as Reflect and Debilitate can help mitigate a lot of the damage. Barricade will completely negate the damage as well, if willing to sacrifice the adrenaline.

infobox.Description: Defeat Raksha, the Shadow Colossus without expelling any poisonous shadow energy from his 'Mind Flay' attack.

achievements.name: Lets Split Up
achievements.description: Defeat Vorago without anyone being hit by his 'Teamsplit' attack during the 'Teamsplit' stage.
achievements.wikiSummary: Lets Split Up is an achievement that requires the player to defeat Vorago without anyone being hit by his 'Teamsplit' attack during the 'Teamsplit' phase.
achievements.wikiText:
Lets Split Up is an achievement that requires the player to defeat Vorago without anyone being hit by his 'Teamsplit' attack during the 'Teamsplit' phase.

## Strategy

Vorago can use his Teamsplit during phases 3, 4, and 5 in normal mode when the rotation is Teamsplit, or in phase 5 when the rotation is set to Ceiling Collapse. Despite the description, it is also required to interact with this mechanic when it appears in phases 4 and 5 during the Teamsplit rotation and cannot be completed nor failed on phase 5 during the Ceiling Collapse rotation. In hard mode, the Teamsplit attack occurs in phase 7, and also in phases 9, 10, and 11 if the rotation is Teamsplit, phases 10 and 11 if the rotation is Ceiling Collapse, phase 10 if the rotation is Scopulus, or phase 11 if the rotation is Green Bomb.

This achievement requires that every time Vorago uses his Teamsplit attack, all players successfully stand in the same coloured square that their character's colour becomes. Players have around 10 seconds to reach the square, reduced in hard mode.

By default all players are eligible for this achievement, and it is only once any player takes damage from the Teamsplit that the message You have failed: Lets Split Up appears and the achievement is no longer awarded. Thus completing a kill where one or more Teamsplit mechanics are skipped, such as by ending phase 3 before the second Teamsplit happens, will not invalidate the achievement.

## Achievement Set

Completing this achievement in a Hard Mode Vorago instance is one of the requirements for the Vorago (HM) (perfect) grandmaster achievement.

Lets Stay Together is an achievement that requires the player to participate in a successful encounter against Vorago without anyone successfully hiding during the "Teamsplit" attack.

## Strategy

Vorago can use his Teamsplit during phases 3, 4, and 5 in normal mode when the rotation is Teamsplit, or in phase 5 when the rotation is set to Ceiling Collapse. Despite the description, it is also required to interact with this mechanic when it appears in phases 4 and 5 during the Teamsplit rotation and cannot be completed nor failed on phase 5 during the Ceiling Collapse rotation . In hard mode, the Teamsplit attack occurs in phase 7, and also in phases 9, 10, and 11 if the rotation is Teamsplit, phases 10 and 11 if the rotation is Ceiling Collapse, phase 10 if the rotation is Scopulus, or phase 11 if the rotation is Green Bomb.

This achievement requires that every time Vorago uses his Teamsplit attack, no player successfully stands in the same coloured square that their character's colour becomes. Every instance of Teamsplit will deal 8,000 hard typeless damage, so make sure to heal accordingly to avoid getting killed by the blast. As the mechanic's initiation disables all defensive abilities, the only way to mitigate the damage is with a powerburst of vitality or Transfigure.

By default, all players are eligible for this achievement, and it is only once any player avoids damage by standing in their coloured square that the message You have failed: Lets Stay Together appears and the achievement is no longer awarded. Thus completing a kill where one or more Teamsplit mechanics are skipped, such as by ending phase 3 before the second Teamsplit happens, will not invalidate the achievement.

## Achievement set

achievements.wikiText:
Lightning Doesn't Strike Once is an achievement that requires the player to defeat any of the six Legiones solo without being hit by their 'Lightning' attack.

## Strategy

The legiones' lightning attack has a 5x5 area-of-effect (starting as a 1x1 area-of-effect on the first tick, 3x3 on the second and 5x5 on the third). Simply maintaining the distance and running in advance is sufficient enough to qualify for the achievement. Since the legiones' main weakness is ranged attacks, nightmare gauntlets and fleeting boots are useful as they allow the player to use certain ranged abilities while moving.

It is recommended to kill Legio Primus for this achievement, since he has the least troublesome mechanics. Legio Secundus and Legio Sextus may also be killed, but Secundus will use his lightning more frequently as his health lowers while Sextus' strikes last longer.

achievements.name: Lumbridge Strikes Back
achievements.description: Defeat Araxxor and Araxxi whilst wearing bronze armour on your head, torso and legs, and a bronze weapon in your main hand. Can only be completed in solo mode.
achievements.wikiSummary: Lumbridge Strikes Back is an achievement that requires the player to defeat all phases of Araxxor and Araxxi while wearing bronze armour in the head, torso, and leg slots and a bronze main-hand weapon. The player is disqualified from the achievement if they stop wearing any of the bronze equipment required for the achievement during the fight. Swapping to another bronze weapon is fine.
achievements.wikiText:
Lumbridge Strikes Back is an achievement that requires the player to defeat all phases of Araxxor and Araxxi while wearing bronze armour in the head, torso, and leg slots and a bronze main-hand weapon. The player is disqualified from the achievement if they stop wearing any of the bronze equipment required for the achievement during the fight. Swapping to another bronze weapon is fine.

This achievement must be completed in a solo private instance.

It is strongly recommended to fight Araxxor at 0% base enrage and while the acid and darkness paths are open. As the achievement only requires a main-hand bronze weapon, dual-wielding is highly encouraged.

Like during a standard kill, the player should cycle between the Anticipation and Freedom defensive abilities to avoid special attacks.

## Required equipment

One of each of these armour pieces must be worn.

One of these weapons must be used. All bronze weapons have an accuracy value of 150, so hit chance against Araxxor and Araxxi will be a significant issue. Neither boss has an explicit weakness, however the affinities of the bosses to different styles are different. Using a one handed weapon is highly recommended over a two handed weapon, as it allows the use of an offhand weapon with a high damage bonus, which may optionally augmented with perks.

## Path

Players should proceed through the darkness path to reduce the amount of damage that needs to be dealt to Araxxor. The fourth phase is about staying calm and focusing on your deflect curse switching to minimise the damage taken, while also avoiding the core in the final 25,000 life points.

Total damage required to be dealt to Araxxor/Araxxi

• Darkness path (bottom) - 75,000 hp.
• Acid path (middle) - 100,000 hp.
• Minions path (top) - 100,000 hp.

## Presets

Magic or Necromancy cannot be used as there are no qualifying weapons for these styles.

Melee offers higher base accuracy than ranged for this activity, as bronze armour won't incur an accuracy penalty, but the player will have to be more careful with the Swipe special attack and when prayer-switching against Araxxi's attacks. With melee, the player's accuracy can be up to 50%.

Recommended melee weapons

Use any bronze melee main-hand weapon (except hatchet or pickaxe) and the highest tier off-hand you have.

Accuracy modifiers

Accuracy is a significant issue for this achievement, so players can gain significant benefit by increasing their own accuracy or decreasing the boss' defence. Attacks with low accuracy will not miss, but they will do decreased damage.

• Attack level boosts such as Overloads or Elder overloads give an additive increase to melee accuracy.
• Prayers such as Turmoil or Malevolence give a percentage increase to melee accuracy.
• The Vampyrism spell or the Darkness incantation improve your longevity by healing you with every attack or giving you a chance to dodge the boss' attacks.
• The Ingenuity of the Humans ability causes the next used ability to hit with 100% accuracy, which is best reserved for high damage ultimate abilities.
• The Statius's warhammer special attack can be used to both reduce Araxxor's and Araxxi's defence by 10%, and increase their affinity by 5, for a 60 seconds. It must be stored inside an Essence of Finality amulet to be able to be used with a bronze weapon.
• The Dragon scimitar special attack can be used to increase the players accuracy by 25% with slash weapons for 60 seconds, so a bronze slash weapon such as a longsword is required to make use of this. The off-hand weapon does not need to be slash, as abilities use the damage type of the main-hand weapon. The special attack must be stored inside an Essence of Finality amulet to be able to be used with a bronze weapon.

Other boosts

• Armour spikes can be used to deal additional damage. Their damage can be slightly further increased by boosting the player's Smithing level with a god banner, which reapplies a +2 Smithing boost for 30 minutes.
• The NopeNopeNope perk from the player owned farm gives up to 3% additional damage against spiders.

Ranged is not as accurate as melee, as bronze armour is classified as melee armour and as such incurs an accuracy penalty to ranged attacks of -77, which can be significant as overall accuracy is low. In a comparable setup, ranged will deal 10% less damage due to this lower accuracy than melee. However, ranged can make up for this reduction in accuracy as it can use Enchanted bolts to apply secondary effects, and the powerful Seren godbow special attack.

Recommended ranged weapons

Use a Bronze crossbow and the highest tier offhand you have.

Accuracy modifiers

Accuracy is a significant issue for this achievement, so players can gain significant benefit by increasing their own accuracy or decreasing the boss' defence. Attacks with low accuracy will not miss, but they will do decreased damage.

• Ranged level boosts such as Overloads or Elder overloads give an additive increase to ranged accuracy.
• Prayers such as Anguish or Desolation give a percentage increase to ranged accuracy.
• The Ingenuity of the Humans ability causes the next used ability to hit with 100% accuracy, which is best reserved for high damage ultimate abilities.
• The Statius's warhammer special attack can be used to both reduce Araxxor's and Araxxi's defence by 10%, and increase their affinity by 5, for a 60 seconds. It must be stored inside an Essence of Finality amulet, and a melee bronze weapon must be brought to make use of this special attack.

Optional equipment

• Diamond bakriminel bolts (e) give a 5% chance (up to 7.2% with the Ranged cape and Hard Seer's Village Tasks) to hit with 100% accuracy, and deal +15% damage.
• Onyx bakriminel bolts (e) give a 10% chance (up to 14.4% with the Ranged cape and Hard Seer's Village Tasks) to deal +25% damage, and heal for 25% of the damage dealt.
• The Saradomin bow special attack can provide substantial healing throughout the fight. It must be stored inside an Essence of Finality amulet.
• Summoning familiars can be used throughout the fight such as a ripper demon or hellhound

## Tips

Image showing 53% hit chance and recommended gear for Melee Araxxor for this achievement.

• As this is a long fight (around 10 minutes), players might wish to bring a beast of burden with brews and Sailfish.
• Boosting one's maximum life points using a bonfire boost (or Totem of Vitality) and the thermal bath effect considerably improves survivability.
• A deathwarden nexus adds the ability to cast defensive abilities like Resonance and Reflect throughout the fight, even when not using Necromancy.
• Placing an elder spider in both medium pens at the player-owned farm with a farm totem will give 3% increased damage against Araxxor and Araxxi.
• Having one or more of Morvran's challenge enhancers active can resurrect the player on the spot with full health if they die as many times as they have active charges. The player doesn't have to be on Morvran's special slayer task to receive this benefit.

achievements.description: Use asphyxiate on Yakamaru's north pool and have the whole raid survive.
achievements.wikiSummary: Make Friends and Influence People is an achievement that requires the player to participate in a successful fight against Yakamaru where Asphyxiate is used while he is in the north-eastern pool and having everyone in the party survive the reflected damage. achievements.wikiText:
Make Friends and Influence People is an achievement that requires the player to participate in a successful fight against Yakamaru where Asphyxiate is used while he is in the north-eastern pool and having everyone in the party survive the reflected damage. This can be done by any member of the team as long as all members of the team survive. Each four of Asphyxiate's hits must deal damage at least once.

## Strategies

The successful hits are checked by the player dealing the Asphyxiate over the course of the phase, and are not limited to one player. If one player using Asphyxiate were to use the ability but cancel it early, the same or another player can use Asphyxiate and successfully deal damage with the fourth hit in order to successfully qualify the team. The four strikes do not have to be within one usage of Asphyxiate.

Teams can survive the recoil damage Yakamaru deals by either using Barricade in a well-timed manner, or for players to retreat towards the southern pool out of range of Yakamaru's attacks. The player using Asphyxiate will either need to use Natural Instinct to be able to gain enough adrenaline to use Asphyxiate under Barricade's effects, using an adrenaline potion of some variant, or for another player (under Barricade's effect) to cast Intercept on the caster. Players may still qualify if they are saved via a sign of life's effect, but no player may die during the rest of the encounter.

## Trivia

• The achievement name is a reference to the self-help book How to Win Friends and Influence People by Dale Carnegie.

achievements.name: Malignant Enigmas
achievements.description: Defeat 18 shadow enigmas in 6 seconds.
achievements.wikiSummary: Malignant Enigmas is an achievement that requires the group to kill 18 shadow enigmas in 6 seconds.
achievements.wikiText:
Malignant Enigmas is an achievement that requires the group to kill 18 shadow enigmas in 6 seconds.

This achievement can be completed in story mode as well as in normal mode.

This achievement unlocks as soon as it is completed. It does not require the completion of the Seiryu the Azure Serpent encounter. This achievement can only be done in a group as in solo the maximum number of enigmas in each wave is 12 and they don't last till the next wave.

The achievement is unlocked for everyone in the group at the same time. All players must stay on the platform below in order to spawn enough enigmas. If any player jumps up to the crystals, not enough enigmas will spawn. One tactic to then get the achievement is by using a combination of area of effect abilities such as Tsunami, Dragon Breath, and Chain in order to kill off the enigmas quickly. If using necromancy, players can use Blood Siphon and Bloat to quickly eliminate enigmas. Alternatively, players can Threads of Fate, Soul Sap, Volley of Souls, and Spectral Scythe. Melee users have a viable option through the passive and special attack of the Tumeken's Light weapon.

In a duo, each player should stand one tile south of the point where enigmas spawn. Some players may find it easier to also aggro each enigma (either by using a weak weapon or their fists); this allows them to reposition the enigmas into a more immediately AoE-friendly shape, instead of the two straight lines that they spawn in. Additionally, enigmas can get stuck behind each other by the time the second wave of 12 enigmas spawn. Using this method, you can aggro the first group of enigmas using your fists and wait until all 24 have spawned. From there, players can use AoE abilities to quickly kill 18 enigmas. Both players should use Tsunami at the same time if using Magic, or Blood Siphon and Bloat if using Necromancy.

achievements.description: Defeat Amascut, the Devourer in enrage mode without failing her 'Altar Strike' attack in phase 7.
achievements.wikiSummary: Menaphiting My Way Through This is an achievement that requires the player to participate in a successful encounter against Amascut, the Devourer in enrage mode without failing her "Altar Strike" attack in phase 7.
achievements.wikiText:
Menaphiting My Way Through This is an achievement that requires the player to participate in a successful encounter against Amascut, the Devourer in enrage mode without failing her "Altar Strike" attack in phase 7.

## Requirements

This achievement requires that players correctly face Amascut to the statues that she calls out in phase 7. She can be faced toward a statue by a player in the direction of that statue using Provoke after she calls out the name of the statue. Any enrage can be used for this achievement, so it is recommended that players complete it at 100% enrage, unless they are looking to complete the perfect achievement, which requires 2,000% enrage.

This achievement is failed if she attacks any incorrect statue in phase 7, or Tumeken directly, which will display the message You have failed Menaphiting My Way Through This.

## Strategy

Facing Amascut toward the correct statues in phase 7 should be done anyway during any Amascut kill, so this achievement simply requires that players do not make any mistakes while doing so. Some tips to make this easier:

• With sufficient damage before in phase 6, and after the statue in phase 7, only one statue will need to be called and provoked.
• One player should be pre-placed in each quadrant before the statue is called, ready to provoke.
• The player must be in the correct quadrant before using Provoke. Provoking her and then moving to the correct quadrant will cause her to attack the statue from where the player was when the provoke was used, not the quadrant that the player moved to.
• Players can leave the quadrant to avoid taking damage after provoking her.

## Achievement set

Completing this achievement at 2,000% enrage is one of the requirements for the Amascut, the Devourer (perfect) grandmaster achievement.
